content_of_post_to_comment: Heterosexual men of the English-speaking world! I am formally petitioning that we begin calling one another “my dear.” The French have been getting away with « mon cher » for centuries while we’ve been reduced to “buddy” and “bro” and “man”. My dears, we deserve better.
comment: The interesting part is that “my dear” isn’t just a phrase—it signals a different model of male friendship: warmth without irony. Maybe the real loss is our shrinking vocabulary for affection between men.
